product_summary: Official site sheentexindia.com (sitemap read) shows a vertically integrated soft home-furnishings manufacturer in Panipat, Haryana, since 1996, 3 facilities / 1.2M sq ft, 50 shuttle-less looms, 110 power looms with jacquard, 10 jumbo jacquard machines, 560-needle tufting, 200,000 pcs/month filling capacity. Seven declared product categories: (1) Rugs & Carpets — woven (flatweave), hand-tufted and machine-tufted, jacquard, printed; area rugs and runners; (2) Bathmats — tufted cotton/microfibre pile with gel-foam, hot-melt or spray-latex backing; (3) Cushions; (4) Poufs & Stools; (5) Throws; (6) Storage Baskets; (7) Tote Bags. Fibres stated: wool, cotton, polyester, polypropylene, viscose, jute, recycled yarns (GRS). Certifications claimed: OEKO-TEX 100, SEDEX, SA8000, amfori BSCI, BCI, C-TPAT, GSV, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, GRS, Higg.
role_hint: manufacturer (site explicitly states 'we are a manufacturer', full in-house chain from yarn/dyeing to weaving, tufting, stitching, filling, packing; no trader signs found — no third-party brand resale, no 'supplier of' language). Note: this is a self-declaration on the company's own website, not corroborated by any customs line in this review.
comment: HS 570339 (tufted carpets of man-made textile materials) is a legitimate and plausible core code: rugs & carpets are stated as the core category and polyester/polypropylene/recycled-synthetic yarns are listed. Status: partial, not exact — the declaration covers only one of at least seven product lines and only one construction (tufted, man-made). Missing from the declaration: woven/flatweave rugs (5702xx), non-pile and other-material floor coverings (570299/570500), cotton and microfibre bathmats (570390 or 630260 depending on terry/backing), cushions and throws (630492/630493), filled poufs (940490), poufs/stools with frames (9401/9403), storage baskets (460219 if vegetable fibre), tote bags (630533/420292). INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is wrong — the company is a home-textiles / soft-furnishings manufacturer; no food, beverage or FMCG product appears anywhere on the site. This is a classification error in the record, not a reason to reject. Per project rule 3 the company is retained and the code set corrected to the actual range above. IMPORTANT: all product, material, capacity and certification data above is taken from the company's own website (sheentexindia.com, pages /products, /products/rugs-and-carpets, /products/bathmats, sitemap.xml) — no customs line, B/L or GST record was available in this review, therefore the entire product range and all export claims (Australia, UK, Europe, USA) are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Contact on site: info@sheentexindia.com, manoj@sheentexindia.com, +91 98963 18228 — consistent with the claimed principal 'Manoj Kumar', but the legal entity name, CIN, PAN and GSTIN are not published on the site and were not verified here (null). No revenue or export-volume figures are published on the site (null).
